meta.notes: Generated 2026-10-30. Bloodborne has no recipe crafting; the 'crafting' layer is Blood Gems + Workshop, Caryll Runes + Memory Altar, weapon fortification with bloodstones, Arcane Haze extraction, and Chalice Rituals (materials + Blood Echoes). Item/material data come from Fextralife (curl-200) tables and pages, farming methods from bloodborne-wiki.com/p/farming.html (curl-200). materials[].qty null = variable amount. Chalice offerings with note 'optional ... rite offering' are only needed for that rite. See NOTES.md.

categories.name: Blood Gems
categories.description: Socketable upgrades for weapon imprint slots (unlocked at +1, +3, +6; firearms have 1 or no slot). Installed and removed freely at a Workshop table once the Blood Gem Workshop Tool is obtained. Shapes: Radial/Triangular/Waning (right-hand), Circle (left-hand, plus Lost Chikage), Droplet (any slot). Rating 1-20; Fextralife's tables show Gemstone gems at ratings 1-10, Damp gems at 11-19 and Abyssal gems at 20.

categories.name: Caryll Runes
categories.description: Runes carved into the hunter's mind at the Memory Altar in the Hunter's Dream, which requires the Rune Workshop Tool. Many runes have several tiers with stronger effects; covenant runes come from joining a covenant.

categories.name: Weapon Upgrades (Fortify)
categories.description: Weapon fortification at the Workshop from +0 to +10 using bloodstones and Blood Echoes; plus the Workshop Haze Extractor, which turns ritual materials into Arcane Haze.

categories.name: Consumables & Projectiles
categories.description: Healing, buff, utility and throwable items, with where to find, farm or buy them (Bath Messenger shop items are unlocked by Hunter Badges).

categories.name: Chalice Rituals
categories.description: The closest thing Bloodborne has to crafting recipes: each Chalice is consecrated at a ritual altar in the Hunter's Dream with ritual materials and Blood Echoes to create a Chalice Dungeon. Root Chalices accept optional Fetid/Rotted/Cursed offerings (and Sinister Bell rites).

categories.name: Insight & Blood Echoes
categories.description: Items and methods for gaining Insight and Blood Echoes (the game's two currencies), including coldbloods and known farming routes.

items.effect: Covenant Rune: Increases stamina recovery speed
items.whereToFind: Complete Eileen the Crow's questline and she rewards you with this rune along with the Crow Hunter Badge.

items.description: Caryll Rune 'Impurity'.

items.whereToFind: Tier 1: Obtained just downstairs of the Hypogean Gaol lamp post. items.name: Short Ritual Root Chalice
items.description: Key item that needs no ritual materials; used to quickly search for Chalice Dungeons online as a guest, host or invader. Since patch 1.04 it is bought from the Insight Bath Messengers for 10 Insight after fully clearing the Pthumeru Chalice Dungeon.
items.whereToFind: -Currently available through: Messenger insight shop for 10 Insight (it is stated in item main page that "after defeating the third layer boss in Central Pthumeru ", however this needs to be confirmed). -Refer to key items for updated and old information. -After patch v1.04, this item is not longer considered a chalice item. It is now a key item and the Pthumerian Elder drops a gem as of the most current patch. More details can be obtained in the key items section for this item.

items.name: Insight sources (summary)
items.description: Ways to gain Insight listed by Fextralife.
items.effect: Insight is spent on the Insight Bath Messenger shop, the Beckoning Bell and Old Hunter Bell; Insight above 0 changes the world (e.g. the Plain Doll comes to life at 1 Insight).
items.whereToFind: Discovering and beating bosses; consuming Madman's Knowledge (+1), Great One's Wisdom (+2), One Third of Umbilical Cord (+3), Blood Dreg (+1); defeating bosses as a co-op guest (+1); being grabbed by the invisible Lesser Amygdala outside Oedon Chapel (+1); entering certain areas for the first time (e.g. Abandoned Old Workshop +2, Nightmare of Mensis +3).

items.name: Blood Echoes sources (summary)
items.description: How Blood Echoes are earned and spent, per Fextralife.
items.effect: Used to level up, buy from Messengers, repair and fortify weapons, and perform Chalice Rituals.
items.whereToFind: Killing enemies; consuming Coldbloods; selling items to the Bath Messenger in the Hunter's Dream.

items.name: Farm Blood Vials & Quicksilver Bullets – Central Yharnam
items.description: Community farming route.
items.effect: Restocks Blood Vials and Quicksilver Bullets.
items.whereToFind: Central Yharnam: Scourge Beasts, Large Huntsmen and Huntsman minions drop Blood Vials; rifle Huntsmen and wheelchair Huntsmen drop Quicksilver Bullets.

items.name: Farm Blood Stone Chunks – Wandering Nightmares (DLC)
items.description: Community method (needs The Old Hunters; reported working on patch 1.09; once per playthrough).
items.effect: Many Blood Stone Chunks (author reports ~140 in 75 minutes).
items.whereToFind: Research Hall / Nightmare Church lamps in the Hunter's Nightmare: kill the Wandering Nightmares without looting, rest and repeat, then loot each corpse repeatedly. Don't die during the process.

items.name: Farm Blood Echoes – visceral attacks in Pthumeru Ihyll root chalices
items.description: Community method using the Heir (tiers 2-3) and Moon (tier 3) runes to boost echoes from visceral kills.
items.effect: Author reports ~407k echoes per ~42 s run (glyph w6qvjakg, Layer 1) and ~550k per ~50 s (glyph wm732fk9, Layer 2); numbers depend on NG cycle and runes.
items.whereToFind: Pthumeru Ihyll Root Chalice glyphs w6qvjakg / wm732fk9 (requires the root chalice and matching rites; shared glyphs can expire).

materials.name: Blood Stone Shard
materials.description: Bloodstone used to fortify weapons up to +3.
materials.whereToFind: Messenger shop for 2,000 Blood Echoes or the Insight Bath Messengers for 1 Insight (both after touching the misshapen skull in Vicar Amelia's boss room); also loot in Central Yharnam, Cathedral Ward and Old Yharnam, and enemy drops.
materials.usedFor: Fortify +0→+3 (3/5/8 per step).

materials.name: Twin Blood Stone Shards
materials.description: Bloodstone used to fortify +3 weapons up to +6.
materials.whereToFind: Messenger shop for 10,000 Blood Echoes after obtaining the Cosmic Eye Watcher Badge; Insight Bath Messengers for 2 Insight after defeating Rom (per Fextralife); loot in Cathedral Ward, Healing Church Workshop, Hemwick Charnel Lane, Forbidden Woods, Nightmare Frontier.
materials.usedFor: Fortify +3→+6 (3/5/8 per step).

materials.name: Blood Stone Chunk
materials.description: Bloodstone used to fortify weapons up to +9.
materials.whereToFind: Insight Bath Messengers for 20 Insight after defeating The One Reborn; loot in Forbidden Woods, Cainhurst Castle, Yahar'gul, Lecture Building 2F, Nightmare of Mensis, Nightmare Frontier, Upper Cathedral Ward, Hunter's Nightmare, Research Hall, Fishing Hamlet; farmable from enemies.
materials.usedFor: Fortify +6→+9 (3/5/8 per step).

materials.name: Blood Rock
materials.description: Largest bloodstone; used for the final fortification to +10.
materials.whereToFind: Insight Bath Messengers for 60 Insight after defeating Mergo's Wet Nurse; one per NG cycle in the Nightmare of Mensis; also loot in Chalice Dungeons and the Fishing Hamlet.
materials.usedFor: Fortify +9→+10 (1 per weapon).

materials.name: Arcane Haze
materials.whereToFind: Workshop Haze Extractor Drop from Fluorescent Flower in Chalice Dungeons.
materials.usedFor: Defiled Chalice; Great Isz Chalice; Great Pthumeru Ihyll Chalice; Sinister Pthumeru Ihyll Root Chalice (optional); Sinister Hintertomb Root Chalice (optional); Sinister Lower Loran Root Chalice (optional); Sinister Isz Root Chalice (optional)

materials.name: Bastard of Loran
materials.whereToFind: Found in Loran Chalices. Chance scales with depth.
materials.usedFor: Defiled Chalice; Cursed and Defiled Root Chalice (optional); Pthumeru Ihyll Root Chalice (optional); Lower Ailing Loran Root Chalice (optional); Isz Root Chalice (optional) Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Bastard of Loran: 5).

materials.name: Bloodshot Eyeball
materials.whereToFind: Drops from Witch of Hemwick. Rare drop by Eye Collectors in Hypogean Gaol.
materials.usedFor: Hintertomb Chalice; Hintertomb Root Chalice; Lower Hintertomb Chalice; Lower Hintertomb Root Chalice; Sinister Hintertomb Root Chalice Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Bloodshot Eyeball: 5).

materials.name: Blooming Coldblood Flower
materials.whereToFind: Rare Drop from Loran Clerics in Loran Dungeons.
materials.usedFor: Lower Loran Chalice; Lower Ailing Loran Root Chalice; Sinister Lower Loran Root Chalice Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Blooming Coldblood Flower: 12).

materials.name: Coldblood Flower Bulb
materials.whereToFind: Drops from Loran Clerics in Loran Dungeons. Drops from Loran Silverbeast
materials.usedFor: Ailing Loran Root Chalice Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Coldblood Flower Bulb: 10).

materials.name: Coldblood Flowerbud
materials.whereToFind: Loran Dungeon loot. Can be bought from Insight Messengers once found.
materials.usedFor: Ailing Loran Chalice Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Coldblood Flowerbud: 7).

materials.name: Inflicted Organ
materials.whereToFind: Lower Pthumerian Labyrinth Layer 3 side room enemy at treasure chest. Rare Drop from Labyrinth Warriors in Pthumerian Dungeons.
materials.usedFor: Lower Pthumeru Root Chalice (optional); Cursed and Defiled Root Chalice (optional); Lower Hintertomb Root Chalice (optional); Ailing Loran Root Chalice (optional) Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Inflicted Organ: 5).

materials.name: Living String
materials.whereToFind: Mother Brain. Can be bought from Insight Messengers once found.
materials.usedFor: Great Pthumeru Ihyll Chalice Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Living String: 24).

materials.name: Pearl Slug
materials.whereToFind: Byrgenwerth Isz Dungeon loot Can be bought from Insight Messengers once found.
materials.usedFor: Great Isz Chalice; Isz Root Chalice; Sinister Isz Root Chalice Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Pearl Slug: 5).

materials.name: Red Jelly

materials.name: Ritual Blood
materials.whereToFind: Random Chalice Dungeon Loot. Sold by Messengers.
materials.usedFor: All Chalices. Quality needed is the same as the depth of the Chalice you are trying to make. Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Ritual Blood (1): 2; Ritual Blood (2): 5; Ritual Blood (3): 7; Ritual Blood (4): 10; Ritual Blood (5): 12).

materials.name: Sage's Hair
materials.whereToFind: Rare Drop from Labyrinth Sage enemies in high level Chalice Dungeons.
materials.usedFor: Cursed and Defiled Root Chalice (optional); Pthumeru Ihyll Root Chalice (optional); Ailing Loran Root Chalice (optional); Lower Ailing Loran Root Chalice (optional); Isz Root Chalice (optional) Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Sage's Hair: 11).

materials.name: Sage's Wrist
materials.whereToFind: Common drop from Labyrinth Sage enemies in low to medium level Chalice Dungeons.
materials.usedFor: Central Pthumeru Root Chalice (optional); Lower Pthumeru Root Chalice (optional); Hintertomb Root Chalice (optional); Lower Hintertomb Root Chalice (optional) Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Sage's Wrist: 5).

materials.name: Tomb Mold
materials.whereToFind: Drops from Rats in all Chalice Dungeons. Drops from Gravediggers in Chalice Dungeons.
materials.usedFor: All Root Chalices. Quality needed is the same as the depth of the Chalice you are trying to make. Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Tomb Mold (1): 2; Tomb Mold (2): 5; Tomb Mold (3): 7; Tomb Mold (4): 10; Tomb Mold (5): 12).

materials.name: Yellow Backbone
materials.whereToFind: Drop from One Reborn (3) Rare drop from Labyrinth Warriors in high level Pthumeru Chalice Dungeons.
materials.usedFor: Pthumeru Ihyll Root Chalice (optional); Lower Ailing Loran Root Chalice (optional); Isz Root Chalice (optional) Can be extracted into Arcane Haze (Yellow Backbone: 11).

materials.name: Blood Echoes
materials.description: Main currency: the blood memories of those cursed by the beast plague.
materials.whereToFind: Killing enemies (amount depends on enemy level/type), consuming Coldbloods, selling items to the Bath Messenger in the Hunter's Dream. Carried echoes are dropped on death.
materials.usedFor: Levelling up, buying/selling with Messengers, repairing and fortifying weapons, performing Chalice Rituals.

materials.name: Insight
materials.description: Second currency, representing eldritch knowledge; capped at 99. Higher Insight lowers frenzy resistance and changes the world (e.g. the Plain Doll comes to life at 1 Insight).
materials.whereToFind: Entering most boss arenas and beating bosses; beating bosses as a co-op guest; Madman's Knowledge (+1), Great One's Wisdom (+2), One Third of Umbilical Cord (+3), Blood Dreg (+1); discovering certain areas (e.g. Abandoned Old Workshop +2, Nightmare of Mensis +3).
materials.usedFor: Insight Bath Messenger shop, Beckoning Bell, Old Hunter Bell (patch 1.07+).
